sanskrit: bhagas tveto nayatu hastagṛhya bṛhaspatiḥ puraetā te astu | devas tvā savitā satyadharmā- -upasadyāṃ namasyāṃ kṛṇotu ||
english: May Bhaga lead thee hence, taking thee by the hand; may Bṛhaspati be thy forerunner. May the god Savitā, whose laws are true, make thee worthy of homage, worthy of approach.

sanskrit: yām aśvinā madhukaśāṃ devā agre ajanayan | tayā tvā patyāṃ otāṃ kṛṇmo madhumatīṃ vayam ||
english: With that sweet whip which the Aśvins, the gods, fashioned at the beginning — with that we entwine thee, suffused with sweetness, into thy husband's love.

sanskrit: uttarā śvaśruvā bhava nanāndur upaśikṣayā | yaśas tvā patyāṃ kṛṇmo bhavā devṛṣu priyā ||
english: Be thou above thy mother-in-law; instruct thy husband's sister. We make thee glorious before thy husband; be thou beloved among the brothers-in-law.

sanskrit: adbhir ātmānaṃ tanvaṃ śumbhamānā gṛhān prehi mahiṣī bhavāsi | tatra tvādur gārhapatyāya devāḥ prajāvatī jaradaṣṭir yathāsaḥ ||
english: Adorning thy person with the waters, enter the house — thou art the chief queen. There the gods have appointed thee to the householder's fire, that thou mayest be rich in offspring, reaching old age.

sanskrit: ud uttaram ārohantī vyasyantī pṛtanyataḥ | abhy aṣṭhāḥ śatror mūrdhānaṃ sahaputrā virāḍ bhava ||
english: Ascending ever higher, scattering those who assail thee — thou hast stood upon the head of thy enemy; be a sovereign queen, accompanied by sons.

sanskrit: śvaśrūṇāṃ śvaśurāṇāṃ gṛhāṇāṃ ca bhagasya ca | vi rāja patyāṃ devṛṣu sajātānāṃ virāḍ bhava ||
english: Over the mothers-in-law, over the fathers-in-law, over the household and its prosperity — reign supreme; among husband, brothers-in-law, and kinsmen of thine own birth, be a sovereign queen.

sanskrit: yad giriṣu parvateṣu goṣv aśveṣu yan madhu | yenākṣā abhyaṣicyanta tenāham asyā mūrdhānam abhi ṣiñcāmi nāryāḥ ||
english: Whatever honey there is in the mountains and highlands, in the cattle and in the horses — with that wherewith the dice were anointed, therewith I anoint the head of this woman.

sanskrit: yad varco gavi kalyāṇe yad vā sūyavase tṛṇe | abhyañjanasya yad varcas tena mānajmi varcasā ||
english: Whatever splendour is in the auspicious cow, or in the grass of a good pasture — with the splendour of this unguent I anoint her with splendour.

sanskrit: yenācarad uśanā kāvyo 'gre vidvān kratūnām uta devatānām | sahṛdayena haviṣā juhomi sadhrīcīnaṃ vo mano 'stūgram ||
english: With that oblation offered with a united heart, wherewith Uśanā Kāvya moved of old, knowing the rites and knowing the deities — I pour libation; may your minds be in full accord, may they be mighty.

sanskrit: mahat satyaṃ mahad dhavir uśanā kāvyo mahān | devānām ugrāṇāṃ satāṃ hṛdayāni sahākaram ||
english: Great is the truth, great is the oblation, great is Uśanā Kāvya. The hearts of the mighty gods, of the righteous ones — these I have joined together.

sanskrit: ahaṃ satyena sayujā carāmy ahaṃ devīm anumatiṃ pra veda | indro devānāṃ hṛdayaṃ vo astu sadhrīcīnaṃ vo mano 'stūgram ||
english: I walk yoked with truth as my companion; I have full knowledge of the divine Anumati. May Indra be the heart of the gods for you; may your minds be in full accord, may they be mighty.

sanskrit: tvaṣṭā vāyuḥ kaśyapa indram agnir manasānv āyan haviṣas padena | avindañ chakraṃ rajasi praviṣṭaṃ sadhrīcīnaṃ vo mano 'stūgram ||
english: Tvaṣṭā, Vāyu, Kaśyapa, Indra, and Agni — they followed with their minds the footprint of the oblation; they found the mighty one who had entered into the atmosphere. May your minds be in full accord, may they be mighty.

sanskrit: yeneme dyāvāpṛthivī vicaṣkabhur yenābhavad antarikṣaṃ svar yat | manasā vidvān haviṣā juhomi sadhrīcīnaṃ vo mano 'stūgram ||
english: With that by which these two, Heaven-and-Earth, were propped apart, by which the atmosphere and the sunlit realm came into being — knowing with the mind, I pour libation with the oblation; may your minds be in full accord, may they be mighty.

sanskrit: dyāvāpṛthivī hṛdayaṃ sasūvatur yenedaṃ tvaṣṭā vikṛṇoti dhīraḥ | tasyośanā kratubhiḥ saṃvidānaś cittaṃ viveda manasi praviṣṭam ||
english: Heaven-and-Earth brought forth the heart by which the wise Tvaṣṭā fashions all this world. Of that heart Uśanā, conversant with the rites, found knowledge — the thought that had entered into the mind.

sanskrit: cittaṃ caitad ākūtiś ca yena devā viṣehire | etat satyasya śraddhayā- -arṣayaḥ sapta juhvati ||
english: This thought and this intent — by means of which the gods achieved their aims — with faith in truth the seven seers pour this as oblation.

sanskrit: tvayā manyo saratham ārujanto harṣamāṇāso hṛṣitā marutvan | tīkṣṇeṣava āyudhā saṃśiśānā upa pra yantu naro agnirūpāḥ ||
english: O Manyu, exulting and exhilarated, mounting the same chariot with thee, their weapons whetted to sharpness, with arrows keen — may the men, of fiery form, advance forward.

sanskrit: agnir iva manyo tarasā sahasva senānīr naḥ sahure hūta edhi | jitvāya śatrūn vi bhajāsi veda ojo mimāno vi mṛdho nudasva ||
english: Like fire, O Manyu, overwhelm with fury; invoked, be our battle-leader, O conqueror. Knowing how to conquer the foes, divide the spoil; measuring out strength, drive away the hostile hosts.

sanskrit: sahasva manyo abhimātim asme rujan mṛṇan pramṛṇann ehi śatrūn | ugraṃ te śardho nanv ā rurudhre vaśī vaśaṃ nayāsā ekaja tvam ||
english: Overwhelm, O Manyu, hostility against us; come, crushing, smashing, annihilating the foes. Thy fierce host has now been held back; thou who art self-born, subdue the submissive to thy will.

sanskrit: eko bahūnām asi manyav īḍitā paśūnpaśūn yuddhāya saṃ śiśādhi | akṛttaruk tvayā yujā vayaṃ dyumantaṃ ghoṣaṃ vijayāya kṛṇmahe ||
english: Thou art one invoked by many, O Manyu; sharpen for battle beast after beast. Unwounded, yoked with thee as ally, we raise a brilliant war-cry to win the victory.

sanskrit: vijeṣakṛd indra ivānavabravo 'smākaṃ manyo adhipā bhaveha | priyaṃ te nāma sahure gṛṇīmasi vidmā tam utsaṃ yata ābabhūvitha ||
english: Maker of victory, like Indra, never faltering — be our protector here, O Manyu. We proclaim thy beloved name, O conqueror; we know that fountain from which thou hast arisen.

sanskrit: ābhūtyā sahasā vajra sāyaka saho bibharṣy abhibhūta uttaram | kratvā no manyo saha medy edhi mahādhanasya puruhūta saṃsṛji ||
english: With might, with the power of a thunderbolt, O arrow-hurler, thou bearest strength, ever supreme over those who confront thee. With purpose, O Manyu, be united with us; be invoked by many, lead us into the midst of great wealth.

sanskrit: saṃsṛṣṭaṃ dhanam ubhayaṃ samākṛtam asmabhyaṃ dattaṃ varuṇaś ca manyo | bhiyo dadhānā hṛdayeṣu śatravaḥ parājitā yantu paramāṃ parāvatam ||
english: The wealth assembled on both sides, gathered together — may Varuṇa and Manyu grant it to us. The foes, bearing fear in their hearts, defeated, shall go to the uttermost distance.
